table:columns.name: CityBlock
table:columns.description: City block number, first component of the parcel key (portal: 'key fields: CITYBLOCK, PARCEL, OWNERCODE').

table:columns.name: Parcel
table:columns.description: Parcel number within the city block, second component of the parcel key.

table:columns.name: OwnerCode
table:columns.description: Taxing-status component of the parcel key: 0 Standard, 1 Redev Taxable, 2 Redev Exempt, 3 In Lieu of Payment, 4 Charity Exempt, 5 Charity Taxable, 6 Mixed Res, 7 Mixed Comm, 8 Sign, 9 Demo/Maintenance Charge (city PrclCode.mdb CdOwnerCode).

table:columns.name: AsrParcelId
table:columns.description: The Assessor's parcel ID in the numbering schema introduced in 2021 (portal field definition for ParcelId).

table:columns.name: ColParcelId
table:columns.description: Unformatted Collector of Revenue parcel ID — the pre-2021 numbering scheme used across many city departments (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: ParcelId
table:columns.description: Unformatted parcel ID in the Assessor's 2021 numbering schema (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: LowAddrNum
table:columns.description: Lowest house number referencing this parcel on its primary street (portal field definition); HighAddrNum is the highest.

table:columns.name: NLC
table:columns.description: City internal numeric street code for the parcel's primary street (see parcels.NLC).

table:columns.name: AsrClassCode
table:columns.description: Assessor's owner-class code (100 Individual, 200 Company, 49 Land Re-Utilization, etc.; city controlled vocabulary 'Assessor Class Code').

table:columns.name: PropertyClassCode
table:columns.description: Statutory property classification: 10 Agricultural, 12 Commercial, 15 Residential, 17 Exempt, plus mixed-class combination codes (city controlled vocabulary 'Property Class Code').

table:columns.name: AsrLandUse1
table:columns.description: Assessor's primary land-use code (city controlled vocabulary 'Assessor Land Use'; e.g. 1110 Single Family Units, 1010 Vacant Residential Lot, 5000 Trade — see parcels.AsrLandUse1 for more codes).

table:columns.name: AsrLanduse2
table:columns.description: Secondary land-use code, 'present, if necessary, otherwise 0' (portal field definition).

table:columns.name: IsAbatedProperty
table:columns.description: 0/1 flag that the parcel has a tax abatement.

table:columns.name: AbatementType
table:columns.description: Program under which the abatement was granted: CH99 Chapter 99, CH100 Chapter 100, CH353 Chapter 353, EEZ Enterprise Zone (city controlled vocabulary 'Abatement Type').

table:columns.name: AbatementStartYear
table:columns.description: First tax year of the abatement period.

table:columns.name: AbatementEndYear
table:columns.description: Last tax year of the abatement period.

table:columns.name: VacantLot
table:columns.description: 0/1 vacant-lot flag (see parcels.VacantLot).

table:columns.name: NbrOfUnitsSource
table:columns.description: Source system for the NbrOfUnits value: 1 DevNet Building Apartment Data, 2/3 DevNet Land Use with/without Building Rec, 10 Permits, 50 Pre-DevNet Parcel Unit Data, 110/120 overrides, 20 Other (city controlled vocabulary 'Number Of Units Source').

table:columns.name: RecDailyDate
table:columns.description: Recorder of Deeds daily-record date for the latest recorded instrument; RecDailyNum, RecBookNum and RecPageNum are the daily number and book/page references.

table:columns.name: AsdLand
table:columns.description: Assessed value of land in dollars (Missouri assessed value = 19% residential / 32% commercial / 12% agricultural of appraised value, RSMo 137.115).

table:columns.name: AsdImprove
table:columns.description: Assessed value of improvements in dollars.

table:columns.name: AsdTotal
table:columns.description: Total assessed value in dollars.

table:columns.name: AsdResLand
table:columns.description: Assessed land value attributed to the residential class portion (AsdResImprove, AsdComLand, AsdComImprove, AsdAgrLand, AsdAgrImprove are the parallel class-portion splits).

table:columns.name: BillYear
table:columns.description: Tax year of the bill the Bill* fields refer to.

table:columns.name: BillLand
table:columns.description: Land assessed value as billed for BillYear; the Asd* vs Bill* distinction (current assessment vs billed assessment) is not formally documented on the portal.

table:columns.name: BillImprove
table:columns.description: Improvement assessed value as billed for BillYear.

table:columns.name: BillTotal
table:columns.description: Total assessed value as billed for BillYear.

table:columns.name: BillTaxAmt
table:columns.description: Total tax amount billed for BillYear in dollars (name-based).

table:columns.name: TaxBalDue
table:columns.description: Outstanding tax balance due in dollars (name-based).

table:columns.name: AprLand
table:columns.description: Appraised (market) value of land in dollars; AprResLand/AprResImprove/AprComLand/AprComImprove/AprAgrLand/AprAgrImprove split it by property class, and AprExemptLand/AprExemptImprove carry exempt portions.

table:columns.name: CostAprImprove
table:columns.description: Cost-approach appraised value of improvements (name-based).

table:columns.name: AsmtAppealType
table:columns.description: Type of assessment appeal filed (city controlled vocabulary 'Assessment Appeal Type').

table:columns.name: PriorAsdLand
table:columns.description: Assessed land value from the prior assessment (PriorAsdImprove/PriorAsdTotal/PriorAsdDate/PriorTaxAmt are the matching prior-cycle values).

table:columns.name: IsHUDQualifiedTract
table:columns.description: Flag that the parcel lies in a HUD Qualified Census Tract (name-based).

table:columns.name: FloodPlain
table:columns.description: Floodplain status of the parcel: 10/11 100-Year Flood all/part in, 50/51 500-Year Flood all/part in, 30/31 Levee all/part in (city controlled vocabulary 'Flood Plain Type').

table:columns.name: SpecParcelType
table:columns.description: Special-parcel type: C/K Condo Master, H Highway ROW, R Other ROW, S Special Account, W Water, X Non-parcel Area (city PrclCode.mdb CdSpecParcelType).

table:columns.name: SubParcelType
table:columns.description: Sub-parcel type code (A Account Separation, B Back Taxes Owed, C Condo, G Garage/Parking Condo, K Commercial Condo, M Multi-Owner, X Other, plus retirement codes; city 'Parcel Sub Type' vocabulary).

table:columns.name: NbrOfSubAccts
table:columns.description: Number of sub-accounts under this parcel (e.g. condo units billed separately; name-based).

table:columns.name: NbrOfCondos
table:columns.description: Number of condominium units associated with the parcel (name-based).

table:columns.name: LRMSParcel
table:columns.description: Flag/identifier linking the parcel to the city's LRMS land-records system (the LRMS acronym appears throughout city address vocabularies without an expansion; not formally documented).

table:columns.name: AcctPrimary
table:columns.description: Flag marking the primary account record for the parcel (name-based).

table:columns.name: GisPrimary
table:columns.description: Flag marking the record that represents the parcel in GIS when multiple accounts share a parcel (name-based); GisCityBLock/GisParcel/GisOwnerCode are the GIS-side key components.

table:columns.name: Handle
table:columns.description: Citywide parcel join key (see parcels.HANDLE); the portal marks the numbering schema DEPRECATED.

table:columns.name: Parcel9
table:columns.description: Nine-digit parcel root built from CityBlock and Parcel (schema BBBBbbPPP), described in legacy city documentation as the 'root of all taxable info'.

table:columns.name: OwnerOcc
table:columns.description: Owner-occupancy dwelling-type code: 1 Single Family, 2 Two-Family, 4 Three-or-Four Family, 5 Five-plus Family, C Condo, X Other (city PrclCode.mdb CdOwnerOccCode).

table:columns.name: FirstDate
table:columns.description: Date the record first appeared in the extract (name-based; not formally documented).

table:columns.name: LastDate
table:columns.description: Date the record was last updated in the extract (name-based; not formally documented).

table:columns.name: OwnerUpdate
table:columns.description: Date of the last ownership update on the record (name-based; not formally documented).
